title: cbs is a wholly owned Materna subsidiary, not independent, which cut its receptivity score
content:
cbs Corporate Business Solutions was previously listed as independent and is not: Materna has wholly owned it since 2005. The correction lowered its receptivity score, because independence was part of why it looked receptive in the first place.

What survives the correction is the capability claim — the strongest manufacturing bench in Germany in this set — and what qualifies it is now doubly constrained. The delivery is SAP-led and the firm is group-controlled, so an SAP-centred practice inside a parent group has two layers of technology direction set above any individual engagement.

The value of this entry is partly methodological. An ownership fact more than twenty years old had been carried in the workbook as its opposite, and checking it changed the score. Ownership is cheap to verify and expensive to get wrong, which argues for verifying it before ranking a firm on independence rather than after.
